facts.fact: ARME's Q1 2026 statistical report lists Starlink as one of three internet access providers in Cabo Verde, with 0.64% of internet subscriptions (about 3,300 of 511,702 total, derived), up 0.20 percentage points on Q4 2025; the other two are CVTelecom (72%) and Unitel T+ (27.3%).

note: ARME gives Starlink's market share of internet subscriptions, not a subscriber count, so no counted fact.
